risks: Compile time: one more load_inline build (9 wgmma instances, ~8 s of nvcc locally without torch headers; est. 30-50 s on the judge) on top of pw23's ~105 s prepare; the build is skipped if fewer than 60 s of budget remain.

Self-zeroing assumes the G arrivals of one call to a tile are contiguous (calls stream-ordered, never two router calls of the same variant concurrently on different streams) and that the grid is one co-resident wave (only such grids are shipped: 128 CTAs at 1/SM, 256 at 2/SM).
Per-tile counters (st['rw_cnt'], 8192 int32) are monotonic; int32 wraps after ~67M calls of one variant.
